title: PostgreSQL password file
whyItMatters: The .pgpass file holds PostgreSQL database passwords in plain text, one line per host and user. A stranger with the file can log in to those databases, which often hold customer records.
source: PostgreSQL documentation, the password file: ~/.pgpass with host:port:database:user:password lines: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/libpq-pgpass.html
notes: libpq ignores the file unless it is mode 0600 on Linux. PGPASSFILE can point at another path, and psql's interactive history may also contain queries. Servers are usually reached over the network, so the file is a direct way in.
